original_justification: The 45-person treatment analysis is restricted to completers returning at follow-up; two nonstarters and seven dropouts are expressly excluded, including two contactable patients. This is a naive completion-based restriction, not simply an analysis omitting missing outcomes. It is inappropriate for the all-randomized assignment effect.
original_unknowns: Which of the contacted excluded patients had ascertained workability is unknown; contact alone does not prove outcome observation.
